signal.opening_range: for each eligible session date, OR high/low are the max high/min low of completed bars beginning 09:30 for opening_range_minutes
signal.breakout_watch: after OR completion, examine the next 18 completed M5 bars (90 minutes); LONG on the first close strictly above OR high, SHORT on the first close strictly below OR low; if neither occurs no event for that date/cell
signal.entry: next contiguous M5 open after breakout bar completion
signal.one_event_per_session: first breakout only per date and frozen cell
signal.failure_midpoint: LONG exit next open after completed close <= OR midpoint; SHORT exit next open after completed close >= OR midpoint
signal.failure_opposite_boundary: LONG exit next open after completed close <= OR low; SHORT exit next open after completed close >= OR high
signal.time_exit: if no frozen failure trigger, exit at next open after maximum_hold_bars completed post-entry bars
signal.session_boundary: all required timestamps through exit must remain within the timestamp-audited date window and no later than 15:35 local; otherwise right-censor
signal.missing_or_ambiguous: right-censor fail-closed; no interpolation, synthetic bars, same-bar execution, or overnight carry

multiplicity.family: all 228 frozen symbol x OR x failure x hold cells
multiplicity.support_rule_predeclared: All frozen cells remain family members. Only cells meeting non-return support prerequisites (>=80 completed events, >=80 dates, >=30 ISO weeks, retention>=0.90) may generate finite max-T statistics; support-ineligible cells receive p=1.

robust_region_gate.adjacency: one-step grid adjacency within same symbol; failure_rule two-level adjacency is one step
